title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: roofing
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Roof sheeting and membrane over safety nets
swms.task: Fix the metal roof sheeting and the PTFE membrane panels to the roof steel, working above safety nets more than 2 m above the stands, with sheets lifted by the crane company's crawler crane.

facts.fallControl: Work is done inside roof edge protection, over safety nets designed and installed under the roof steel before sheeting starts.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection was considered for every task, and an elevating work platform where edge protection cannot be fixed.

steps: Set up roof access and fall protection
Lift materials to and from the roof
Work with the crane crew during lifts

rules.phrase: installed so a person falling into the net will not hit anything below it
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 306J
rules.quote: so that a person falling into the net will not hit anything below the net
